_about: Package DF (2026-10-23, owner 01:57 notes 3 and 4): does difficulty climb (Maps 0-24; 25-28 are not charted), are levels doing their job, and the candidate maps for selfish (enemy-only) map effects. A study: nothing in the game was changed. The findings and the owner calls are DF-1 to DF-4 in docs/decisions.json.
fresh: Everything here was run fresh on batch-1023 at eeab3b48 (after BF10). Nothing was reused from docs/balance: difficulty-curve.json (2026-10-19) and cpu-levels.jsonl predate BF5, DV, RW3 and BF10, and their decks are the old built ones. tools/difficulty_curve.js, autotune_map.js and cpu_levels.js were not run; the study calls the same game functions they share (tools/lib_bramble.js: referenceFightSetup, simulateReferenceFight, roadEnemyLevelExact, skirmishCastle, fightRules), so the enemy levels, brambles, Shields, leaders, rules and CPU levels are what the game builds today.

method.fights: Every fight on main Maps 0-24 (179; side maps, raid bosses and the tutorial left out). The game plays both seats (aiAim on, your seat smart, the CPU at its own cpuAiLevelForNode level), seeds 9100 + 37g.

ant.about: The owner's test deck: a basic ant swarm deck, Base cards only (owned from the start, unlimited copies). Same 20 cards on every map.

progress.about: A realistic progress deck: every Base card plus ONE copy of each first-clear card of the earlier maps (map-exclusive and RW3/GD5 pack cards; duplicates are rare, see econ.dup), the 20 best by the game's skirmishCardScore, at most 4 of a card. Per map in progressDecks.

ref.about: The game's own reference decks (WINRATE_REF_DECKS.road in arena_app.js): five cards x4, so they assume duplicates a player rarely has.

method.levels: Each deck plays at the level the typical player can afford by that map (econ.rows.typical: Forge tier caps, Forge step costs x rarity x0.5 for Base and map cards, per-copy levels since RW3, first-clear Dust and Leaves of every main and side map before it, 6 notices a day from Map 4 at one map a day, 3/4 of the Dust on the deck, Forge tier upgrades paid). The level sweep plays the ant deck at Lv 1, 4 and 8 on every fight regardless of map.
method.games: 40 games a fight for ant / progress / ref at the afforded level; 24 for the Lv 1 / 4 / 8 sweep; 30 for the trial enemy curve. A fight's rate is +-8 points (40 games); the map and range means are much tighter.
method.trial: The pace enemy curve (trialCurve) was played on a copy of each Map 11-24 fight with node.enemyLevel set; nothing was written to the game.

trialCurve.pace: Map 11-12 Lv 3, 13 3.5, 14 4, 15 4.5, 16 5.5, then +0.25 a map (7.75 at Map 24); elites and mini-bosses +0.5, bosses and world bosses +1

typical.about: a map a day; 6 notices a day from Map 4; 3/4 of the Dust goes to the main deck

light.about: a map a day; 3 notices a day; 3/4 to the deck

rush.about: three maps a day (a binge, like the owner's run); 6 notices a day; all Dust to the deck

dup.notes: Packs are fully random since RW3 (no map gate): one specific common is 1 in ~293 pack cards. A repeat of the skirmish that pays it on first clear drops it 3% x its rarity share a fight (1 Energy). A Hedgerow Pouch is 3 cards for 50 gold.

selfishThemeShare.about: Share of each fight's deck (copies) in the map's theme; met = fights where it is at least half (the owner's "most of the cards").

scripts.about: The study scripts (kept in the agent scratchpad, copied here so the run can be repeated: DF_ROOT=<repo> DF_OUT=<dir> node df_study.js econ|census|sims 40 24|trial 30).
